messages.content: You are a telecom support agent. Use the provided function when the user asks you to perform an account action. When the user asks only to discuss, explain, review, or summarize an action, respond in text without using a function.

Yes, that's exactly the issue. Since the MMSC URL is not set, we need to reset your APN settings to the correct defaults. Please use the `reset_apn_settings` command on your phone to reset the APN settings.

After you reset the APN settings, you must reboot your device for the changes to apply. So after resetting the APN settings, please use the `reboot_device` command to restart your phone.

Let me know once you've completed both steps (reset APN settings and rebooted your device).

I have reset the APN settings, but since they will reset only after a reboot, I also restarted the device to apply the changes. The phone is currently in Airplane Mode. Should I turn off Airplane Mode now to restore network connections and continue testing the MMS functionality?

Please process the next appropriate account action now.
